entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Imperial champion of the Empire of Madara, torn between honor and Nicol Bolas, who renounces his title and kills Overdark and Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Vicious emperor of Madara and planeswalker, defeated by Tetsuo.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Tetsuo's rival, an imperial assassin who becomes regent and is killed by Tetsuo.

entities.name: Haki Umezawa
entities.description: Tetsuo's father and clan leader of Clan Umezawa.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Distant ancestor of Tetsuo.

entities.name: Clan Umezawa
entities.description: Tetsuo's clan.

entities.name: Shasido Mayasi
entities.description: Kentsu general defeated by Tetsuo for the champion's title, who became a hermit on Kusho.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: Tetsuo's second.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Tetsuo's armorer, later poisoned during the kentsu campaign.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Healer in Tetsuo's entourage, infected by Xira's larva and later killed.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: Cat-dragon who attacked Sekana and became champion's deputy there.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: Overdark's agent who placed her larva in Kei, hunted down by Tetsuo.

entities.name: Lady Orca
entities.description: Sent by Overdark to attack the Edemis wearing Tetsuo's house symbol; defeated by Tetsuo.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: Leader of the Edemi rebellion who let Tetsuo leave in peace.

entities.name: Lord Magnus
entities.description: Searched for a remedy for Kei.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: General of the kentsu killed on Overdark's orders.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Bogardan pilgrim who weakens Tetsuo's loyalty and obliterates Overdark's keep.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Imperial army sent to campaign on the Edemis.

entities.name: Edemis
entities.description: Islands in rebellion against Madara.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: Empire ruled by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War begun when the Edemi rebellion flared up.

entities.name: Sekana
entities.description: Port attacked by Wasitora and later by a kentsu regiment.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Island where Shasido became a hermit.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: Plane where Tetsuo trained and defeated Bolas.

entities.name: Imperial Shrine
entities.description: Residence of Overdark and Bolas, destroyed by the Meteor Hammer.

entities.name: Meteor Hammer
entities.description: Spell cast by Tetsuo that destroyed the Imperial Shrine.

entities.name: Ærathi
entities.description: An oppressed group seeking to improve its situation.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War during which Tetsuo was champion.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Bolas needed a mana foothold.

events.summary: At fifteen Tetsuo replaces his father in a formal duel and kills his first human.
events.quote: This was the first time Tetsuo killed another human.

events.summary: Tetsuo defeats Shasido Mayasi to become imperial champion.
events.quote: Tetsuo defeated Shasido in combat and earned the title.

events.summary: Tetsuo duels the cat-dragon Wasitora at Sekana; after an Elder Land Wurm interrupts, he spares her and she becomes champion's deputy.
events.quote: Wasitora helped kill the creature, and Tetsuo realized he didn't have to kill her.

events.summary: Overdark lures Tetsuo to the Edemis by having Xira Arien infect Kei with her larva.
events.quote: He lured Tetsuo to the Edemis by having Xira Arien place her larva in Kei Takahashi

events.summary: Tetsuo defeats Orca and Arien and destroys Overdark's serpent generator.
events.quote: Tetsuo defeated Orca and Arien and destroyed Overdark's trump card, a serpent generator .

events.summary: Lady Caleria lets Tetsuo leave, and the insect in Kei is killed though mutations remain.
events.quote: Tetsuo and Ayesha did manage to kill the insect in Kei

events.summary: Bolas sends the kentsu to the Edemis and forces Tetsuo to join; Tetsuo's loyalty weakens after the kentsu's dishonorable behavior and a talk with Kolo Meha.
events.quote: Tetsuo's willingness to follow the emperor weakened.

events.summary: Overdark has Elsdragon killed and is made regent; Tetsuo, finding Ayesha poisoned, Tor wounded and Kei killed, renounces his title and swears vengeance.
events.quote: Tetsuo renounced his title of champion and swore vengeance.

events.summary: Tetsuo hides on the Meditation Plane while Wasitora's kittens destroy a kentsu regiment sent to Sekana.
events.quote: The regiment was destroyed by Wasitora's kittens

events.summary: Tetsuo hunts down Xira Arien and brings a meteor shower on the kentsu at the Imperial Shrine.
events.quote: Tetsuo summoned a meteor shower to dispose of them.

events.summary: Tetsuo kills Overdark in single combat and absorbs his powers, aided by Meha's destruction of Overdark's Keep.
events.quote: Tetsuo managed to kill Overdark and absorb his powers.

events.summary: Tetsuo flees to the Meditation Plane and destroys the Imperial Shrine with Meteor Hammer; denied his planeswalker powers, Bolas is defeated.
events.quote: Denied his powers as a planeswalker, Bolas was defeated by Tetsuo.

events.summary: Tetsuo reunites with Meha, Tor and Ayesha and sets out to restore the chaotic empire.
events.quote: Tetsuo was reunited with Meha, Tor, and Ayesha

relations.quote: Tetsuo managed to kill Overdark and absorb his powers.
